candidates.change_summary: Pass address(this) instead of msg.sender as the new oracle's owner so the deployed EmergencyOracle has a different owner, changing the observable address/ownership surface.
Pass a hardcoded non-zero literal description instead of the caller-supplied description so the deployed oracle's public description() differs.
Pass address(0) as the oracle owner, which makes transferOwnership revert so newEmergencyOracle always fails and no oracle address is produced.
Check isAdmin[tx.origin] instead of isAdmin[msg.sender] so the set of callers allowed to reach newEmergencyOracle changes, altering which calls complete.
Replace the admin check with require(true) so anyone can call newEmergencyOracle, changing observable behavior for non-admin callers.
